harness: tools/g0_rig.py on tools/sms_frame_harness.py: original Z80 code, approximate VDP, NTSC frame timing (262 lines x 228 cycles; the ROM's own PAL flag D12D is 0 and is not read anywhere in the results or title path).  Frame offsets are harness frames relative to the act-clear entry ($14AE / $1543); attaching PC hooks can move a later event by +/-1 frame.  The tally is CPU-bound, so its steps-per-frame figures are per NTSC harness frame, not per PAL frame.
